summary: Frontend-only regression for the new Thailand product page (/asien/siam-splendour-thailand) plus regression on Sri Lanka, Egypt Luxor, Morocco+Egypt, Asia listing, unknown slug redirect, and header mega-menu. All spec-listed acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: eg-detail-price-value data-testid is used on BOTH mobile price card and desktop sidebar. Playwright strict-mode locator resolves to 2 elements. Not a bug (only one is visible per breakpoint) but consider distinct suffixed testids (e.g. eg-detail-price-value-desktop / -mobile) for cleaner E2E selection.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Detailed verifications performed:
- Thailand desktop 1440x900: egypt-detail-page renders; title 'Siam Splendour: 9-Day Thailand Odyssey'; price '₹63,650'; facts '9 days'+'4 cities'; route chips Bangkok/Chiang Mai/Chiang Rai/Doi Inthanon/Phuket present; document.documentElement.scrollWidth=1440 (no overflow); 0 console errors.
- Reel hero: data-layout='portrait', 7 tiles (eg-reel-tile-0..6), tiles 0 and 3 are videos with badge+mute; after 3s both <video> paused=false readyState=4 (webm source, headless).
- Mute toggle (eg-reel-mute-0): aria-label toggles 'Unmute reel' ↔ 'Mute reel' and BOTH videos share muted state (verified via document.querySelectorAll('video').map(v=>v.muted) → [false,false] after click).
- Arrows: initial prev has opacity-0, next visible. Clicking next scrolls track (scrollLeft 0→469). After multiple clicks: prev visible, next opacity-0 at far right.
- Photo tile eg-reel-photo-1 opens eg-lightbox with eg-lightbox-image, caption contains 'Siam' + '1/5'; eg-lightbox-next advances to '2/5'; Escape closes; eg-gallery-button ('5 photos') also opens lightbox, close button works.
- Expert card: eg-expert-title = 'Trip created by Ananya Iyer, Thailand & Vietnam expert at Hi Tours'.
- eg-route-section-0..2 count=3.
- Price card services: '3 hotels', '14 activities', '2 flights + 4 transfers', '9 meals' all present.
- Recommended: heading 'Other Asia holidays…' present; does NOT include 'Siam Splendour'.
- Sticky bar eg-detail-sticky-bar visible after scrolling and contains '63,650'.
- Mobile 390x844: scrollWidth=390, no horizontal overflow. eg-reel-prev/next and eg-gallery-button are hidden. eg-detail-mobile-price shows ₹63,650. Dots update: active dot index 0→1 after scrolling track by 260px.
- Asia listing /asien: product cards order: 1st '/asien/siam-splendour-thailand' (Siam Splendour), 2nd '/asien/emerald-isle-explorer-sri-lanka'. Click on Siam link navigates to /asien/siam-splendour-thailand.
- Sri Lanka regression: eg-gallery-desktop present, eg-gallery-video-desktop present (Vimeo iframe shown; Vimeo displays 'couldn't verify security…' in headless as expected). eg-reel-track absent. eg-gallery-image-1..4 all present. Title matches; price ₹94,472.
- Egypt Luxor regression: eg-gallery-desktop present, eg-gallery-image-0..4 all present, no eg-reel-track, price ₹1,44,000.
- Morocco+Egypt: title 'Morocco & Egypt: Palaces, Medinas & Pyramids'.
- Unknown slug: /asien/does-not-exist → https://.../afrika/aegypten (redirect works).
- Header Destinations mega-menu (desktop hover): Thailand anchor href='/asien/siam-splendour-thailand' confirmed via DOM. Egypt and Sri Lanka links live under Africa/Asia tabs; COUNTRY_HREF map in /app/frontend/src/components/DesktopMenus.jsx line 7 confirms { Egypt: '/afrika/aegypten', 'Sri Lanka': '/asien', Thailand: '/asien/siam-splendour-thailand' }.
- Console errors on Thailand desktop = 0. Across all pages 6 errors were captured: two 401s (external analytics resources) and 4 informational '%c%d font-size:0;color:transparent NaN' messages — not blocking and unrelated to this task.
rca of the issue: N/A — all acceptance criteria pass. Only observation: shared data-testid 'eg-detail-price-value' on mobile+desktop price cards causes strict-mode duplicate locator (cosmetic testability concern, not a functional bug).
